name: keypaste
description: Lets Claude ask for one credential from your KeePass database, with your approval and a full audit trail.
long_description: This extension starts the keypaste installed on this computer as Claude's MCP server and carries no copy of its own, so install keypaste first. The server never opens your database: it asks the keypaste app or `keypaste approve`, whichever holds it unlocked, which answers under the settings you gave this agent and records each request.
